segments.label: Passkey login
lines: XORR is a mobile-first trading app. Sign in with one passkey: no seed phrase, and nothing that can sign is stored. Test funds land at your own address.

segments.label: AUSD balance
lines: On the Perps screen, your AUSD balance is the margin in your Perpl desk: an account the agent can trade, but never withdraw from.

segments.label: A trade on Perpl
lines: Then a trade on Perpl: a long on MON, with its distance to liquidation and its exits, then closed, with the margin back in the desk.

card.title: An AUSD-margined desk, filled on Perpl

lines: On Monad testnet, a team-seeded desk funded with a hundred and fifty AUSD filled its trade on Perpl.

card.title: A council of AI agents trades for you on Monad, and one hold stops it on chain.

lines: XORR. Trade with AUSD, on your phone.
